creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-09-28: "self compaction", then "maybe both? Claude Code right now claims it can't self compact but through muster we maybe could."

Two halves:
- An agent asks Muster to compact it. Claude Code has no tool for /compact, but Muster can type into the agent's own pane; a line typed while the agent is working is queued and runs when its turn ends. A verb (or documented recipe) for this, with a focus argument, and the skill telling agents when to use it.
- Muster compacts an agent past a threshold on its own, e.g. context over 80% while idle. Muster already knows context used from the statusline hooks (extras/claude-code). Needs a setting, and care never to type into a prompt a person is using: the doorbell's rules (ring only an empty prompt it reads positively) are the model.

Related: a_2Y6brssqH (muster pane wait on context over 80%).
title: 🗜️ An agent can compact itself, and Muster can compact one past a threshold
